$comment: SealLink v1.0 Service Types Registry (SPEC-03, SPEC-07). Standard lowercase types are reserved and updated via SLIPs. Permissionless custom types use reverse-domain namespace (e.g., com.example/car-lock).

standard_types.description: Sovereign email hosting and delegated mailbox access (read, list, send) decoupled from identity.
Bounded autonomous agent task briefs, tool execution, contract-bound isolated sessions, and guardian-verified instruction intake.
Sovereign XMPP instant messaging hosting where the actor's manifest declares the active server.
Replaceable content-addressed blob storage (e.g., Blossom BUD-01/02/04 grant-aware profile).
Grant-gated cryptocurrency/payment execution service (strictly concrete executor and UTXO seal).
Delegated ledger name-update service (update-only; registration and transfers require separate custody).
Model inference proxy / metered compute service (supports window_only ephemeral grants and bearer sessions).
Physical or digital asset rental / lease control (vehicles, apartments, hardware); requires bilateral contract.
